data.cultural_impact: The name Rocco gained popularity in Southern Italy and Sicily, where St. Roch is greatly venerated. The name is often used as a nickname for children born on the feast day of St. Roch, which is August 16. It is also a common name in Portuguese-speaking countries, particularly in Brazil.
data.spiritual_significance: St. Roch is believed to have healing powers, especially during times of plague or illness. The name Rocco is thus associated with strength, protection, and healing. It is a name often given to babies born into families who seek the intercession of St. Roch during difficult times.
